name: Cure Critical Wounds, Mass
text:
**Cure Critical Wounds, Mass**

**School** conjuration (healing); **Level** cleric 8, druid 9, oracle 8, shaman 8, witch 9
**Casting Time** 1 standard action
**Components** V, S
**Range** close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
**Target** one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
**Duration** instantaneous
**Saving Throw** Will half (harmless) or Will half; see text; **Spell Resistance** yes (harmless) or yes; see text

This spell functions like mass cure light wounds, except that it cures 4d8 points of damage +1 point per caster level (maximum +40).
